purpose: Mechanism study of what hard-capped level-crossing eventization preserves or loses in guided-wave SHM. The protocol preserves the E7 representation contract while separating immutable historical evidence, fresh v2.4 source receipts, metadata-only schema gates, and one-shot confirmations.

predecessor_invalidation.required_boundary: v2.1, v2.2, and v2.3 protocols, receipts, schema gates, caches, scores, and conclusions are integrity history only. They cannot authorize v2.4 waveform access or substitute a v2.4 schema/result decision.

morpho_mapping_provenance.decision_rule: The final MORPHO mapping below is selected once from the official ReadMe/reader-example semantics plus the prior no-value structural inventory. Neither discovery phase reads HDF5 values, labels-for-scoring, waveform scores, caches, or result-dependent choices.

historical_e7_binding.allowed_use: E7's existing healthy representation is immutable calibration provenance for D12/D16 only. v2.4 produces a new calibration-binding receipt before E9; E7/E8 are never recomputed, edited, or represented as a new confirmation.

global_rules.system_boundary: Post-compensation software representation only. No MCU, ADC, acquisition power, embedded latency, energy, deployment, calibrated field FAR, or probability-of-detection claim is permitted.
global_rules.unit_of_analysis: monitoring record or predeclared monitoring block; paths, receivers, and repeated waveforms are components and never independent statistical samples

prohibited_uses: enter any v2.4 source receipt or runner input

global_rules.confirmation_rule: D12 and D16 are each scored once only under this frozen grid, followed immediately by the read-only result audit. A code defect invalidates the attempt and requires a named successor, never a silent rerun.
global_rules.historical_boundary: E7 and E8 remain immutable historical evidence. The aluminum 2021_03-to-2021_04 replay remains E8 only; 2021_06, 2022_07, and 2022_08 are ineligible for a healthy-to-damage confirmation claim.
global_rules.external_boundary: MORPHO and COQTEL first receive fresh v2.4 raw-byte receipts and metadata-only schema gates. No external waveform value, score, label-for-scoring, cache, E9 result, or signal conclusion is authorized by a historical receipt.

ogw_representation_contract.source: same 40 kHz high-pass, unit-energy-normalized OBS+BSS residual representation as strict-evaluation-v1

baseline_pool.selection: temperature-stratified deterministic selection frozen in the E7 strict-cache manifest

quantization.scale_fit: maximum absolute residual value over healthy training residuals only

payload_accounting.capacity_allocation: equal per-path cap including variable-length framing; choose the largest integer path cap whose framed worst-case total does not exceed the record capacity
payload_accounting.charge: actual serialized path timestamp gaps, signed level changes, path framing, and full record packet bytes
payload_accounting.cap_decoder_behavior: stop before the first event that would exceed the path cap and hold the final transmitted quantized level for the remaining samples

diagnostic.normalization: per-feature median and MAD with a 1e-12 scale floor
diagnostic.head_reporting: always report both heads; neither may be selected after scoring

waveform_metrics.aggregation: record-level deterministic path aggregation defined in src.methods.mechanism_v2.record_waveform_metrics

loss_decomposition.quantization_only: input compared with unbounded quantized-level reconstruction
loss_decomposition.hard_cap_truncation: unbounded quantized-level reconstruction compared with bounded decoded reconstruction
loss_decomposition.score_head_mismatch: healthy-normalized dense/reconstructed waveform energy and the fixed event-native score are reported without labels

representation_propositions.quantization_collision: When two code paths have identical quantized level sequences, their SoD event time/level streams and serialized payload are identical. A canonical nonzero integer sub-level probe is reported as not applicable for delta_codes less than or equal to two.
representation_propositions.terminal_hold: After a hard path cap rejects an event, suffix waveform differences that do not alter the already serialized prefix cannot pass to the decoder; canonical divergent suffix evidence is required for every capacity and delta.

healthy_control_injections.source: chronologically evenly spaced healthy OGW training records only
healthy_control_injections.interpretation: Representation probe only. It neither creates real damage evidence nor supports a diagnostic, operational, or deployment claim.

statistics.binary_labeling: Only a predeclared official healthy versus official degradation/damage/failure stage may become a binary label. Mixed-label groups are invalid for group bootstrap.

group_bootstrap.unit: predeclared campaign/block or monitoring-record group, never path/receiver/repeat waveform

statistics.single_transition_metrics: If a single onset is reported, use only false calls/day, new-alarm delay, and coverage. Do not call it probability of detection or calibrated field FAR.

schema_gate: sortable official fatigue-block path token and frozen block order
official Healthy group token and Status attribute name
official fatigue/degradation group tokens and Status attribute name
all ten repetitions for one block/frequency/actuator are components of that block and cannot cross a split
raw waveform path, sample axis, sampling-rate attribute name, and monitoring group identity are structurally recoverable
morpho.split: fit only on Healthy_Clamped; evaluate held-out Healthy_Unclamped together with the frozen ordered fatigue blocks. No validation threshold or configuration selection exists, so no artificial third split is made from repeated measurements. Every repeat remains in its block group for all group-bootstrap calculations.
morpho.limitation: The data expose only two structurally distinct healthy Active blocks. Therefore the external result must report its one-held-out-healthy-block limitation and cannot be represented as a broad field generalization.

schema_gate: official EC_time/time-or-stage array structurally aligns with State_n groups
both named HDF5 experiments are present as independent campaign identifiers
raw waveform path, sample axis, sampling-rate attribute name, and state/campaign grouping are recoverable
adjacent 10-second states never become independent bootstrap samples
coqtel.split: The two HDF5 files remain distinct campaign groups. State records remain chronological components only; no result-dependent cutoff is permitted.
coqtel.binary_label_caveat: The frozen documentation/metadata mapping proves an official time-associated state sequence but does not provide an official binary healthy-versus-corroded cutoff. v2.4 may report the metadata gate but must not manufacture a ROC/AUC label cutoff from signal values or temporal quantiles.

copv.activation: permitted only when MORPHO or COQTEL fails its schema gate before any waveform scoring
prohibited_activation: because an eligible dataset performs poorly
because COQTEL lacks a frozen binary cutoff while its metadata schema passed

morpho_fod7.mapping_scope: metadata-only eligibility and predeclared path semantics; no HDF5 data/attribute values, waveform metric, event score, label cutoff selection, or result-dependent mapping choice
morpho_fod7.official_state_source: Official ReadMe: Healthy_Clamped/Healthy_Unclamped are healthy baselines; XkN_N subblocks are fatigue degradation states. Status is checked by attribute name only in the pre-score gate.
morpho_fod7.label_rule_for_future_one_shot_runner: Healthy_Clamped and Healthy_Unclamped map to label 0; the listed fatigue blocks map to label 1 solely by the frozen official path-token mapping, never by a value-derived threshold.
morpho_fod7.monitoring_group_definition: A fatigue/baseline block is the statistical monitoring group. Frequency, actuator, receiver channel, and the ten repeat datasets are within-block acquisition components and cannot create independent bootstrap samples.
morpho_fod7.repeat_split_rule: All components whose path has the same block token receive exactly one split assignment; no repeat, actuator, frequency, or receiver subcomponent may cross blocks/splits.

coqtel_corrosion.mapping_scope: metadata-only eligibility; no waveform values, score, binary label cutoff, or result-dependent choice
coqtel_corrosion.campaign_block_definition: One State_n within one named Essai_Corrosion campaign is a chronological monitoring component; the campaign remains the independent replication group and adjacent state records never become independent bootstrap units.
coqtel_corrosion.no_posthoc_cutpoint_rule: No temporal percentile, final-state comparison, visual trend, or signal score may create a healthy/corroded binary cutoff after schema access.

go_no_go: A high-level mechanism submission requires D12/D16 and at least one external dataset to pass their predeclared schema/analysis gates and finish one once-only confirmation. Otherwise retain a rigorous negative-result audit for a standard SHM venue; no hardware, power, real-time, deployment, PoD, or field-FAR conclusion is introduced.
